StepTitle: BATTERY switch ON. Left/Right GEN switches in NORM/ON.

CoderNotes: Both fire-test sides were completed. Following manual review policy, raw fire-test completion timing is not used for A/B order scoring; no OM/OR coded.

StepTitle: APU switch ON. APU READY light illuminated.
CoderNotes: APU start support completed and APU-ready evidence was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Right throttle at IDLE. Throttle moved when RPM >=25%.

CoderNotes: Bleed-air cycle completed after right RPM reached >=60%; no error coded.

StepTitle: Light test executed with all annunciators verified.
CoderNotes: Lights test completion evidence was observed; no error coded.
